description: Starts a booking for a specific demo time slot. startTime must be an ISO-8601 string returned by list_demo_slots. Nothing is booked yet when this call succeeds: the attendee is sent a confirmation email, and the demo is booked only once they click the link in it. Tell the user to check their inbox (and spam folder); do not tell them the demo is booked.

message.description: Optional context about what the attendee wants to discuss (use case, framework, team size).

startTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC start time of the slot to book, exactly as returned by list_demo_slots.

name: book_demo_slot
